A few practical details

Terms of use

Information to help you use the café’s menu and visitor pages.

Menu and business information

The website presents the supplied menu, prices, business location, phone number, and hours for Bahattar Cafe in Itahari. Prices are in Nepalese Rupees. Availability, prices, ingredients, hours, and applicable charges should be confirmed directly with the café.

Planning a visit

Opening hours need owner confirmation before launch. The reported average spend of Rs. 500–1,000 per person is an estimate and does not guarantee a particular bill. The precise street address, holiday hours, facilities, and payment options have not been confirmed.

Orders and bookings

This website provides information and direct contact links. It does not accept payment, submit food orders, or confirm table bookings. Any service arrangements must be made directly with the café.

Food information

Names and supplied ingredient descriptions do not establish complete allergen information. Check dietary needs, ingredients, and shared preparation equipment with the café before ordering.

External links and photographs

Google Maps operates separately from this website. Verify the destination before travelling. Photographs were supplied for this project and show the café and photographed food or drinks; they do not establish the identity, current availability, or serving size of every menu item.

Contact

For corrections or questions, call 982-0347351. The café owner should review these terms before public launch.
